sentences.show: At 10:59, one minute before the war ended, an American soldier charged German machine guns.
The Germans tried to wave him away. He kept going.
World War One ended on this day in 1918.
Germany signed at 5 a.m., in a railway carriage near Compiègne.
But the guns would only fall silent at 11:00. The eleventh hour, of the eleventh day, of the eleventh month.
Until then, the guns kept firing.
On that last day, 2,738 men died.
Henry Gunther had been demoted for a letter home about the misery at the front.
He wanted to make good. At 10:59, he was killed.
One minute later, the guns fell silent.
Pershing named him the last American killed in the war.
Also on this day: Ned Kelly was hanged, and London buried its Unknown Warrior.
